turn: The parcel status store now enforces a whitelist of status transitions in src/store/transitions.js. A parcel can go from accepted to in_transit, from in_transit to itself or out_for_delivery, and from out_for_delivery to delivered or back to in_transit. delivered is terminal. A parcel with no previous status can be given any first status, so new records aren't blocked. I checked the transitions by reading the table against the intended lifecycle, and I stepped through the allowed and rejected moves for each status, including the repeat in_transit scan and the terminal delivered case. I didn't add or run an automated test suite for this step, so that coverage is manual. In the same commit I made one small unplanned fix. While in the file I noticed the module's exports were inconsistent with how the store imports them, and I corrected that so the import resolves cleanly. Next I'll start "Public tracking lookup".

sidefix.title: Fix inconsistent transitions module export
sidefix.what: Corrected the export in the transitions module so the store's import of canMove resolves properly.
